Make a Square Image From Any Photo
Crop or pad any photo into a clean 1:1 square — a free, private square image tool that runs entirely in your browser. No signup, no watermark, no upload.
Drop an image here, or browse
PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to 25 MB. You can also paste from your clipboard.
Runs entirely in your browser. Your image is never uploaded.
Make an image square in three steps
Nothing to install and nothing to learn. You go from photo to square in well under a minute.
- 01Upload your imageDrag and drop, browse, or paste any PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF. It loads instantly in your browser.
- 02Crop or fit to squareDrag the box to crop exactly what you want, or switch to fit and pad the whole picture with any background.
- 03Download the squareSave your 1:1 image at full resolution. No watermark, no account, and no waiting in a queue.
Crop or fit: two ways to make a square image
Every photo becomes a square one of two ways. Pick the mode that keeps what matters most in your image.
Crop to square
Cut a 1:1 region out of your photo. Drag to reposition and zoom in or out to frame exactly what you want, then download a tight, fully-filled square with no borders.
Best for social posts, avatars and thumbnails where the square should be completely filled.
Fit to square
Keep the entire photo and pad the shorter sides with a background color until the canvas is a perfect square. This is how you make an image square without cropping anything out.
